tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background. Lodge (default) is a room with the lights off. Insomnia is fluorescent kitchen light at 4 a.m., greenish and sick.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, inputs, menus on background.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and table rules. Never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, quiet buttons). 3:1 or more on background and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on background, surface and lamp-soft (12:1 or more). Bone white in Lodge.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata, hints, timestamps on background and surface (5.2:1 or more).

tokens.name: curtain
tokens.usage: Blood-dark velvet red. Large fields only: full-height side slabs, full-bleed bands, the primary button. Text on it is on-curtain. Not a text color in Lodge (2.4:1); use curtain-text.

tokens.name: curtain-deep
tokens.usage: The inside of a fold. Hover and pressed state of the primary button, the outer edge of a red band, the shadow side of a duotone image.

tokens.name: curtain-text
tokens.usage: Red used as text: errors, destructive links, the word 'now'. On background and surface (6:1 or more).

tokens.name: on-curtain
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on curtain and curtain-deep (6.7:1 or more).

tokens.name: lamp
tokens.usage: The sick magenta light that falls on faces. Links, the focus ring, the one live element on a screen. Text on background, surface and lamp-soft (5.1:1 or more).

tokens.name: lamp-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind a selected row or a live stamp. Text on it is text or lamp.

tokens.name: hearth
tokens.usage: Warm lamplight that exists only at the start of an animation (the cozy phase) and drains away. Never a static fill or text color.

tokens.name: floor-light
tokens.usage: Light chevron stripe. Only inside ChevronRule and the cover band, always paired with floor-dark.

tokens.name: floor-dark
tokens.usage: Dark chevron stripe and the ground of the chevron band.

tokens.name: marble
tokens.usage: Statue white. Oversized numerals (WakeClock) and one glyph on Lodge background. Vanishes on Insomnia; use text there.

tokens.name: silver
tokens.usage: Mid-grey of the mirrored print. The MirrorPanel axis and texture fills. Not a text color.

tokens.name: blade
tokens.usage: The black spike on the mirror axis. Fills only.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 3:1 or more on background and surface in both themes.

families.display: "IM Fell English", "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Cover and one title per page. Never two on a screen.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section openers, empty states, error pages.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: I closed my eyes and the room stayed.
styles.usage: Quote body. Italic means speech, nothing else.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Nobody asked you to stay awake. You stayed anyway.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The record was saved at 03:47. It was saved again at 03:47.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Hints, table cells, secondary text in text-muted.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: Stamp component and section indices. Always uppercase.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Figure captions, quote sources, timestamps. Lowercase.

styles.name: transcript
styles.sample: 03:47. Still here. The light in the hall is on again.
styles.usage: Logs, dictated notes, anything that reads like a tape transcript.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between a stamp dot and its text, a glyph and its label.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Label to input, stamp padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list row padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Default gap between controls, phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, panel padding.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; cover chevron pitch.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Gap between major regions; width of the mirror axis zone.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every surface and control. The room has no soft corners.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Inputs and stamps only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: The lamp dot: status dots and one marker. Nothing round is larger than 12px.

tokens.name: lamp-glow
tokens.usage: The one lit element on a screen. Never on buttons.

tokens.name: fold
tokens.usage: Bottom fold on curtain fields and the pressed primary button.

effect.note: Values for the doubling, grain and the three-phase light arc (cozy, cooling, failing). Applied by bundle.css; everything stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: ghost-red
tokens.usage: First half of the ghost text-shadow: a red double offset to the right. Use with ghost-lamp, display styles only, once per screen.

tokens.name: ghost-lamp
tokens.usage: Second half of the ghost text-shadow: a magenta double offset to the left.

tokens.name: grain-opacity
tokens.usage: Opacity of the noise layer over Veil images and the page background.

tokens.name: flicker-duration
tokens.usage: Length of one failing-light cycle: a slow sag, one blink, a two-flash burst, a brownout. At most two flashes in any one second.

tokens.name: cozy-duration
tokens.usage: Phase 1: the warm, slow fade-in every animated element starts with.

tokens.name: cozy-ease
tokens.usage: Easing of the cozy phase and of hover fills: soft arrival, long settle.

tokens.name: cool-duration
tokens.usage: Phase 2: the warmth drains out of the light and the room goes cold.

tokens.name: dread-delay
tokens.usage: When phase 3 (the failing light) starts: cozy-duration plus cool-duration.
